label: ET91000SM20 gigabit copper-to-fibre converter (SM LC, 20 km)
description: Gigabit copper-to-fibre converter with one 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 port and one SFP cage shipped with a 1000BASE-LX single-mode LC module good for 20 km at 1310 nm. The module is removable, so SX/LX/EX/ZX or a 1000BASE-T SFP can be swapped in instead.
